# Mob Agent Crew — LLM control entrypoint

Mob Agent Crew is a file-native collaboration environment for humans and CLI
Agents. The browser, the external `mob` CLI, and an Agent running on another
computer all operate on the same conversations, runs, files, and Wiki.

Canonical control guide:
https://github.com/cdotlock/mob-agent-crew/blob/main/docs/llm-control.md

Install the external CLI (Node.js 22+, Git, and Corepack are required):

    git clone https://github.com/cdotlock/mob-agent-crew.git
    cd mob-agent-crew
    sh scripts/install-cli.sh

Connect without putting a password in shell history:

    printf '%s' "$MOB_PASSWORD" | mob login \
      --server https://web-production-9e8cff.up.railway.app \
      --email you@example.com \
      --password-stdin

Discover the environment before acting:

    mob task list
    mob conversation list
    mob agent list
    mob model list
    mob wiki list --area wiki

Import a local Markdown tree without following hidden paths or symlinks:

    mob wiki import-dir ./docs --area raw
    mob wiki import-dir ./curated-wiki --area wiki

Run and observe an Agent:

    mob agent invoke <task-id> @builder "inspect the failure and fix it"
    mob run watch <run-id>
    mob run steer <run-id> "also run the focused regression test"

Chat and Agent execution are intentionally separate. A normal message does not
start compute. Use `agent invoke`, `conversation send --invoke`, or the browser's
explicit Run action when work should begin.

Agent identity is a thin composition:

    identity + harness + model + skill references + environment references

Mob owns collaboration state and access rules. Each installed harness still
owns its private implementation and memory. Never send provider or GitHub keys
through chat, Wiki, task files, command arguments, or Agent environment fields.

Wiki is available through the browser's Wiki button and through `mob wiki`.
Use `mob wiki ask "question"` for a natural-language retrieval with file
citations; use `mob wiki read <path>` to inspect the cited Markdown source.

GitHub setup status is human-only and secret-free:

    GET /api/integrations/github/status

It returns only whether the server is configured plus safe setup commands; it
never returns a token. Model discovery is available through `mob model list`
or `GET /api/models`.

Human-only operations include Agent registration, GitHub setup, review,
publication, database replay, and server configuration. Agents may propose
changes and publish artifacts, but may not approve SCM writes.
